gemini.rationale: The Downstream products and physical operating assets (refineries, pipelines, marketing outlets) transferred together, resulting in no gap_45. However, the operating workforce transferred without the parent-level corporate support infrastructure (cash management, shared infrastructure), creating a structural gap_56 that was mitigated at closing by a Transition Services Agreement.

grok.rationale: At closing the Downstream customer-facing base (refineries, branded outlets/brands, pipelines, JV interests) crossed together with its physical operating substrate and approximately 12,400 operating employees, so T4 product and T5 processes moved as one package and T5 processes moved with the T6 workforce that ran them (gap_45=0, gap_56=0). The parent-level corporate service substrate that did not cross intact was bridged by a Transition Services Agreement, but that shared-overhead bridge is not a product-vs-process or process-vs-ops-org mismatch in the transferred Downstream package.

openai.rationale: The downstream customer-facing assets, brands, refineries, outlets, pipelines, and processing capacity crossed, but the shared corporate infrastructure supporting those operations did not transfer intact, documenting a product-versus-process gap at closing. That gap was contractually absorbed through the Transition Services Agreement and related commercial agreements covering transitional services, utility allocation, delivery-system maintenance, and commodity supply. Approximately 12,400 downstream operating employees crossed with the operating base, while the omitted corporate support organization corresponded to the shared processes that also remained with ConocoPhillips, so no separate process-versus-organization mismatch is documented.
